paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: if you follow Jesus, the world may not like it, and that is not a sign you did something wrong. Jesus says, "If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first." (John 15:18) He also says, "No servant is greater than his master." (John 15:20) So when people push back because of His name, you're walking the same road He walked, and He walked it first.

Now, why does Jesus tell them this ahead of time? He says, "I have told you these things so that you will not fall away." (John 16:1) Think of a weather alert that shows up BEFORE the storm. It doesn't make the storm smaller, it just means you're not blindsided, and you can say, "He told me about this." Jesus says it Himself: "so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them." (John 16:4)

And listen, you are not standing out there alone. Jesus says the Spirit of truth, the Advocate, "will testify about Me." (John 15:26) Then He says, "And you also must testify." (John 15:27) So, baker, hold on to Jesus, speak up about Him, and let the Spirit do what only He can do.
